subject: Interview cadence and fallback coverage plan
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Talent <hiring@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Interview cadence and fallback coverage plan

Hi team —

We have an ACME candidate (Jordan Lee) running a two-day loop next week (Mon-Tue). Recruiting just shared the schedule and we have two weak spots that need firm backfills and a fallback strategy in case of last-minute drops:

- Mon 11/23 14:00 PST — System Design (60m) — currently assigned to Ravi (on-call that afternoon)
- Tue 11/24 10:30 PST — Product deep-dive (45m) — assigned to Priya (has a PTO half-day)

Constraints:
- Keep panel size at 3 where possible, prefer senior engineer + PM + hiring manager for product deep-dive.
- Avoid scheduling system design during active pager windows if possible; if unavoidable we need a float interviewer planned.
- Candidate is in EST (Jordan is flexible between 11:00–15:00 EST).

Ask: can each of you confirm availability to cover one of the slots or nominate a backfill? I attached a quick coverage matrix — please fill your name / fallback and any blackout windows. Also flag if you want to reduce the panel for the deep-dive (I can brief recruiting).

Attachments: interview_coverage_matrix.xlsx (blank matrix), debrief-template.md

I'll consolidate and send calendar invites once we have confirmations. If someone drops <24 hours out, our fallback is: route to on-call pool -> recruiting triggers candidate delay or replacement. Let me know objections.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Product Recruiting (acting)
Redwood Inference

Lauren —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick availability and proposals below (filled the matrix as well):

- I can take the System Design slot Mon 11/23 14:00 PST if Ravi confirms he'll hand off pager duty (I can be backup on-call escalation if needed).
- For Product deep-dive Tue 11/24 10:30 PST I can serve as the PM slot but I recommend slimming the panel to 3: PM + hiring manager + senior eng. If Priya is doing hiring manager, I suggest swapping the senior eng to Victor (he's already familiar with the codebase and flexible Tue afternoon).

If Neha or Grace prefer taking the deep-dive, I'm happy to swap — I can be the float for system design in that case.

I've updated the spreadsheet: row for Jordan Lee -> System Design = Tessa Morgan (primary), Grace O'Connor (fallback). Product = Tessa Morgan (alt) / Victor (suggested).

On logistics: please include timezone in calendar invites and set a 5-minute buffer between interviews for note-taking.

Great — thanks for the quick replies. Consolidated plan below and next steps. I've updated the matrix in Drive and created tentative calendar invites (will send final invites when you confirm).

Consolidated assignments (primary / fallback):
- Mon 11/23 14:00 PST — System Design: Tessa Morgan / Grace O'Connor
- Tue 11/24 10:30 PST — Product deep-dive: Neha Kapoor (primary) / Tessa Morgan (fallback) — panel reduced to 3 (Neha + Priya as HM + Senior Eng)

Fallback process (agreed):
- If primary interviewer cancels <24 hours out: Recruiting pages fallback -> fallback accepts and Recruiting confirms candidate timing change if needed.
- If no fallback available: recruiting will move candidate to next slot and inform hiring manager.

Action items:
- Tessa / Grace / Neha: please confirm on this thread by EOD and accept the calendar invites when they land.
- Recruiting: please set the invites with timezone labels and 5-minute buffer blocks and attach debrief-template.md to each invite.

Attachments: interview_coverage_matrix.xlsx (updated), debrief-template.md

Thanks all — will route to Priya and Ravi for FYI since they are original assignees.

Lauren
